d: Bihar ke lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ki mahima hi kuchh aisi hai ki iski aastha sarahdon aur sat samandar ki duriyon ko bhi par kar jati hai. chhathi maiya ke prati vishvas, parivar ki khushiyan aur apni mitti se jurav ka aisa hi ek bhavuk najara rohtas jile ke dehri men son nadi ke tat par dekhne ko mila. jahan sat samandar par skotlaind men rahne vali anshu apne pati rahul patel ke sath chhath mahaparv ka anushthan karne pahunchin. udayman bhagvan bhaskar ko arghy arpit karte samay unke chehre par santosh, aankhon men khushi aur man men chhathi maiya ke prati atut aastha saph jhalak…
